about_the_game:
Enlist the ship-girl Shōkaku from the universe of Azur Lane to fight on your behalf in the seas of World of Warships, along with a the tasteful “Azur Lane — Siren” permanent camouflage. The personification of the Japanese aircraft carrier of the same name, she can take command of your Japanese ships and comes with a unique voiceover.

This package includes:
  • Japanese Commander Shōkaku with 10 skill points and an individual voiceover
  • 1x "Azur Lane — Siren" permanent camouflage

You can own an unlimited number of copies of Commander Shōkaku.
The Azur Lane — Siren permanent camouflage can be mounted on any ship. Once mounted, the camouflage is assigned to that ship. You can have an unlimited number of The Azur Lane — Siren permanent camouflages.
This time-limited exclusive DLC is only available until July 2, 2025.
